title: Not working as well as I expected in baking
text: Not working as well as I expected in baking. I wanted this primarily for baking.  I know enough to warm water and wisk things together before I add it to the recipe.  The amount of water needed seems highly variable, and that is an issue when you are baking recopies that only need a single tablespoon of water.  The results have been subpar so far.  Taste is good, but the dough tends to be too wet or falls apart.  Cookies also do not spread nearly as much as normal.  For the price, I expected better.
